audit_findings.title: Explicit verification required before high-value action
audit_findings.problem: User might tap confirmation accidentally when moving quickly.
audit_findings.why_it_matters: Accidental submissions cause immediate user panic, refund requests, or phantom tickets.
audit_findings.ux_principle: Nielsen Heuristic #5: Error Prevention (Slips and Mistakes)
audit_findings.recommendation: Use explicit swipe-to-confirm affordance or 8-second undo snackbar.

audit_findings.title: Preserve previous search filters and recent location memory
audit_findings.problem: Users frequently re-enter the exact same dietary filter or sprint squad view.
audit_findings.why_it_matters: Forcing recall rather than recognition increases cognitive friction.
audit_findings.evidence: Observed default filter reset on screen revisit.
audit_findings.ux_principle: Nielsen Heuristic #6: Recognition Rather Than Recall
audit_findings.recommendation: Store top 3 recent selections in local cache with 1-tap re-activation.
audit_findings.validation_test: Track filter click frequency in product analytics.

audit_findings.title: Real-time ETA and courier milestone synchronization
audit_findings.problem: Static progress bars create anxiety if status doesn't refresh within 30 seconds.
audit_findings.why_it_matters: Users wonder if the system stalled or network disconnected.
audit_findings.ux_principle: Nielsen Heuristic #1: Visibility of System Status
audit_findings.recommendation: Include subtle pulsing live indicator and 'Updated 5s ago' timestamp.
audit_findings.validation_test: User anxiety feedback survey during active orders.
